## Tried
- `2026-11-11` DECISION: Credit note lines never look up tax. They copy tax_rate from the original InvoiceLine and negate amount and tax_amount, so a refund after a rate change (e.g. FR last January) reverses exactly what was charged and the VAT return balances. Credit notes use their own gapless sequence (CN-<TENANT>-<YYYY>-<5 digits>, credit_sequences.json) via SequenceStore(prefix=...); the number is taken only after all validation passes.
- `2026-11-11` Design: lines arg = 1-based positions on the invoice; only finalized invoices can be credited; reason required. Invoice JSON round trip (meterbill/invoices/serialization.py): decimals as strings, money as minor units, loader rejects totals that don't match lines. Added --json to the invoice command (unrequested) so credit has a file to read.
